title: GPT-OSS-20B · Baseline vs aiDAPTIV vs LMCache

metricDefinitions.output_tps: Output tokens / benchmark duration (aggregate across requests), higher is better
metricDefinitions.ttft_median_ms: Per-batch median time-to-first-token; scenario value = arithmetic mean of 3 batch medians, lower is better
metricDefinitions.tpot_median_ms: Per-batch median time-per-output-token; scenario value = arithmetic mean of 3 batch medians, lower is better
metricDefinitions.normalized_tps_per_c_reported: User-reported output_tps / concurrency. Do not interpret as GPU-normalized throughput.
metricDefinitions.improvement_percent: For TPS: (candidate / baseline - 1)*100. For latency: (1 - candidate/baseline)*100. Negative = worse.
metricDefinitions.headline_aggregation: Unweighted arithmetic average of 8 matched scenario improvement percentages after averaging R1/R2/R3 within each scenario; not global throughput increase
metricDefinitions.rounding_caveat: Headline percentages are original printed 2dp values; scenario metrics original printed 2dp; scenario gains original printed 1dp. Averaging rounded printed scenario gains does not exactly reproduce printed headline.

limitations: Model weight/tokenizer equality has not been independently verified by hashes.
Different physical GPUs, vLLM/container versions and cache mechanisms: end-to-end configuration comparison, not isolated causal effect of SSD KV offload.
Random independent prompts and repeated fixed seeds may benefit native vLLM prefix caching; not controlled CacheBlend/non-prefix reuse.
Actual SSD KV cache store/retrieve hit telemetry is not presented; no claim of SSD performance improvement.
R1 vs R2/R3 is order-of-repetition, not independently controlled cold/warm.
All three benchmark workloads were run concurrently on same server; possible shared CPU/RAM/NVMe contention.
Text log values rounded at 2dp. Do not represent them as full-precision raw server values.
